plainTranslation: The Mars person's desire and the Venus person's affection usually find each other easily. This is clean attraction with less friction than the harder contacts. Keep putting effort into tenderness, because easy chemistry still needs care to become relationship skill.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryShort: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth.
summaryDeep: Their initiative, urgency, directness, and temper work smoothly with your affections, tastes, and sense of worth. It runs easily and asks little, quietly steadying the rest of the bond. Lean on how naturally this one lines up.
tension: Failure mode: taking the ease for granted. Because the connection does not demand constant effort, it can quietly stop being fed.
advice: Keep choosing it. Just because something feels natural does not mean it can run forever on its own.
